content: I need to ___ a decision quickly.
explanation: make a decision 是固定搭配，意为「做决定」。

content: Can you ___ me a favour?
explanation: do sb a favour 是固定搭配，意为「帮某人一个忙」。

content: She ___ a photo of the sunset.
explanation: take a photo 是固定搭配，意为「拍照」。
zh: 她拍了一张日落的照片。

content: Let's ___ a break.
explanation: take a break 是固定搭配，意为「休息一下」。

content: I ___ a mistake in the test.
explanation: make a mistake 是固定搭配，意为「犯错」。
zh: 我在考试中犯了一个错误。

content: He ___ his homework after dinner.
explanation: do homework 是固定搭配，意为「做作业」。

content: Please ___ attention to the teacher.
explanation: pay attention to 是固定搭配，意为「注意」。

content: We should ___ care of the environment.
explanation: take care of 是固定搭配，意为「照顾、爱护」。

content: The film was very ___ ; I laughed a lot.
explanation: funny 意为「好笑的」；fun 多指「有趣的（事）」。
zh: 这部电影很好笑，我笑了很多次。

content: I was ___ in the story from the beginning.
explanation: 人作主语描述感受用 -ed 形式 interested。
zh: 我从一开始就对故事感兴趣。

content: She gave me some useful ___ .
explanation: advice 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。
zh: 她给了我一些有用的建议。

content: There is a lot of ___ in the room.
explanation: furniture 是不可数名词。

content: Could you give me some ___ about hotels?
explanation: information 是不可数名词。
zh: 你能给我一些关于酒店的信息吗？

content: He has made great ___ in English.
explanation: progress 是不可数名词，make progress 意为「取得进步」。
zh: 他的英语取得了很大进步。

content: The weather is ___ today.
explanation: 描述天气好可用 good；well 多指身体健康。

content: He speaks English ___ .
explanation: 修饰动词 speaks 用副词 well。

content: I ___ my keys on the table.
explanation: leave sth somewhere 意为「把某物落在某处」。

content: I ___ the train this morning.
explanation: miss the train 意为「错过火车」。
zh: 我今天早上错过了火车。

content: Can you ___ me the way to the station?
explanation: tell sb sth 结构；say 后一般直接接内容。
zh: 你能告诉我怎么去车站吗？

content: She ___ three languages fluently.
explanation: 说某种语言用 speak。
zh: 她能流利地说三种语言。

content: We ___ about the plan for hours.
explanation: talk about sth 意为「谈论某事」。
zh: 我们讨论这个计划讨论了好几个小时。

content: I'd like to ___ a complaint.
explanation: make a complaint 是固定搭配，意为「投诉」。

content: Please ___ your time — there's no rush.
explanation: take your time 意为「慢慢来，不着急」。

content: The doctor told him to ___ weight.
explanation: lose weight 意为「减重」；loose 是形容词「松的」。

content: I have to ___ an appointment with the dentist.
explanation: make an appointment 是固定搭配，意为「预约」。

content: The two theories are ___ different.
explanation: 修饰形容词 different 用副词 completely。

content: He was ___ accused of theft.
explanation: 修饰动词 accused 用副词 wrongly。

content: She has a strong ___ of humour.
explanation: a sense of humour 是固定搭配，意为「幽默感」。

content: This medicine has no side ___ .
explanation: side effect 意为「副作用」；affect 是动词。

content: The new policy will ___ everyone.
explanation: affect 是动词「影响」；effect 多作名词。

content: I'm afraid I ___ with you.
explanation: disagree with sb 意为「不同意某人」。
zh: 恐怕我不同意你的看法。

content: He ___ to the plan without hesitation.
explanation: agree to a plan 意为「同意某个计划」；此处 agree 后直接跟 to the plan 作宾语补足语结构，用 agreed 最简。
zh: 他毫不犹豫地同意了该计划。

content: The company had to ___ its workforce.
explanation: reduce 意为「削减」；refuse/reject 是「拒绝」。

content: Please ___ me of the meeting tomorrow.
explanation: remind sb of sth 意为「提醒某人某事」。

content: I can't ___ to buy a new car.
explanation: can't afford to do 意为「负担不起」。

content: She ___ a lot of effort into the project.
explanation: put effort into 意为「在……上投入精力」。
zh: 她在这个项目上投入了很多精力。

content: We must ___ the problem seriously.
explanation: take sth seriously 意为「认真对待某事」。
zh: 我们必须认真对待这个问题。

content: The plan fell ___ because of lack of funding.
explanation: fall through 意为「（计划）落空、失败」。
zh: 由于资金不足，计划落空了。

content: I need to ___ up my mind.
explanation: make up one's mind 意为「下定决心」。

content: He ___ up with a brilliant idea.
explanation: come up with 意为「想出（主意）」。
zh: 他想出了一个绝妙的主意。

content: Don't ___ up — keep trying.
explanation: give up 意为「放弃」。

content: The meeting was ___ off until next week.
explanation: put off 意为「推迟」。

content: She ___ after her mother.
explanation: take after 意为「（外貌或性格）像（长辈）」。

content: I'll ___ into the matter at once.
explanation: look into 意为「调查」。

content: We ran ___ of petrol on the motorway.
explanation: run out of 意为「用完」。
zh: 我们在高速公路上没油了。

content: The evidence is ___ to the case.
explanation: be crucial to 意为「对……至关重要」，用形容词。

content: He was reluctant to ___ responsibility.
explanation: take responsibility 是固定搭配，意为「承担责任」。

content: The report ___ light on the causes of the failure.
explanation: shed light on 意为「阐明、使……清楚」。
zh: 这份报告阐明了失败的原因。

content: We should ___ account of the risks.
explanation: take account of 意为「考虑到」。
zh: 我们应该把风险考虑进去。

content: His argument doesn't ___ up to scrutiny.
explanation: hold up to scrutiny 意为「经得起推敲」。

content: The two events are closely ___ .
explanation: be related 意为「相关联」，用过去分词作形容词。

content: She was ___ of the danger.
explanation: be aware of 意为「意识到」。

content: The plan is ___ to fail.
explanation: be bound to do 意为「必定会」。

content: This is ___ to the previous discussion.
explanation: be relevant to 意为「与……相关」。

content: He tends to ___ the point.
explanation: miss the point 意为「没抓住要点」。

content: The company is ___ a loss.
explanation: make a loss 意为「亏损」。

content: We need to ___ the issue at its root.
explanation: tackle an issue 意为「着手解决某个问题」，语气比 handle 更强调正面应对。
zh: 我们需要从根源上解决这个问题。

content: The findings ___ doubt on the theory.
explanation: cast doubt on 意为「使人对……产生怀疑」。
zh: 这些发现让人们对这一理论产生怀疑。

content: She has a ___ for detail.
explanation: have an eye for 意为「对……有鉴赏力、很敏感」。

content: The argument doesn't ___ water.
explanation: hold water 意为「（论点）站得住脚」。

content: The committee was ___ in its condemnation.
explanation: be + 形容词作表语；unequivocal 意为「明确的、毫不含糊的」。
zh: 委员会的谴责毫不含糊。

content: The reforms were met with ___ resistance.
explanation: stout resistance 意为「顽强的抵抗」，形容词修饰名词。

content: His remarks were ___ to the point of rudeness.
explanation: be blunt to the point of... 意为「直率到……的地步」。
zh: 他的话直率到近乎粗鲁。

content: The proposal was ___ rejected.
explanation: summarily 意为「即刻地、不加讨论地」，修饰 rejected。

content: The two accounts are ___ irreconcilable.
explanation: 修饰形容词 irreconcilable 用副词 mutually。
zh: 这两种说法彼此无法调和。

content: The evidence was ___ at best.
explanation: circumstantial evidence 意为「间接证据」。
zh: 这些证据充其量只是间接的。

content: He was ___ to admit his error.
explanation: be loath to do 意为「不情愿做」；loathe 是动词「厌恶」。
zh: 他不愿意承认自己的错误。

content: The policy had ___ effects on rural areas.
explanation: deleterious 意为「有害的」，形容词修饰名词。
zh: 该政策对农村地区产生了有害影响。

content: The argument rests on a ___ premise.
explanation: spurious 意为「站不住脚的、虚假的」。
zh: 该论证建立在一个站不住脚的前提上。

content: Her account of events was ___ with the facts.
explanation: be consistent with 意为「与……一致」。
zh: 她对事件的叙述与事实相符。

content: This book is ___ .
explanation: 名词性物主代词 mine 单独使用，后面不接名词。

content: Give the pen to ___ , please.
explanation: 介词后接宾格 me。

content: ___ are my friends.
explanation: 作主语用主格 They。

content: I like ___ new bike.
explanation: 修饰名词用形容词性物主代词 his。

content: She hurt ___ while cooking.
explanation: 主语和宾语指同一人时用反身代词 herself。

content: These shoes are ___ .
explanation: 名词性物主代词 hers 独立使用。

content: I made this cake ___ .
explanation: 强调「亲自」，用反身代词 myself。
zh: 这个蛋糕是我自己做的。

content: We enjoyed ___ at the party.
explanation: enjoy oneself 是固定搭配，意为「玩得开心」。
zh: 我们在聚会上玩得很开心。

content: Help ___ to some fruit.
explanation: help oneself to 意为「自便取用」。

content: ___ of the two answers is correct.
explanation: neither of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用单数 is。

content: I have two sisters. ___ of them is a doctor.
explanation: each of + 复数名词，谓语用单数。
zh: 我有两个姐姐，她们各自都是医生。

content: There is ___ milk left.
explanation: milk 不可数；a little 表示「还有一点」。

content: ___ students passed the exam — only three.
explanation: few 表示「几乎没有」，与 only three 呼应。
zh: 几乎没有学生通过考试，只有三个。

content: Is there ___ here who speaks French?
explanation: 疑问句中用 anyone。
zh: 这里有会说法语的人吗？

content: ___ in the class knew the answer.
explanation: 表示「所有人」用 everyone。
zh: 班上每个人都知道答案。

content: I'd like ___ else to help me.
explanation: 肯定句中表示「某人」用 someone。

content: ___ of the three options works.
explanation: 三者及以上的否定用 none。

content: The problem ___ is not difficult.
explanation: 反身代词 itself 用于强调「本身」。

content: They built the house ___ .
explanation: 反身代词 themselves 强调「亲自」。
zh: 他们自己盖了这座房子。

content: This is not my umbrella; ___ is blue.
explanation: 名词性物主代词 mine 作主语。
zh: 这不是我的伞，我的是蓝色的。

content: He is taller than ___ .
explanation: 比较从句中作主语的代词用主格 I（口语中常用 me）。

content: The choice is between you and ___ .
explanation: 介词 between 后用宾格 me。

content: ___ you or your brother has to go.
explanation: either... or 表示两者之一，谓语就近一致用单数。
zh: 你或者你弟弟得去一个。

content: The team congratulated ___ on the win.
explanation: 主语 the team 视为整体，反身代词用 itself。
zh: 球队为这场胜利自我祝贺。

content: ___ of us had ever seen such a thing.
explanation: none of us 表示「我们中没有一个」。
zh: 我们谁也没见过这种事。

content: He blamed ___ for the failure.
explanation: 主语和宾语同指一人时用反身代词。

content: One should always be true to ___ .
explanation: 主语 one 对应的反身代词是 oneself。

content: The book is ___ ; I bought it last year.
explanation: 作表语的名词性物主代词用 mine。
zh: 这本书是我的，我去年买的。

content: ___ of the two roads leads to the village.
explanation: either of + 复数名词，谓语用单数，表示「两者任一」。
zh: 这两条路哪一条都通向村子。

content: I have ___ to tell you.
explanation: 肯定句中用 something。

content: ___ who wants to come is welcome.
explanation: anyone who... 表示「任何想……的人」。

content: She is not ___ to blame.
explanation: be not oneself 意为「状态不佳」，此处指她本人不在状态。

content: We gave the prize to ___ won.
explanation: whoever 在从句中作主语。
zh: 我们把奖给了获胜的人。

content: ___ he says should be taken seriously.
explanation: whatever 引导主语从句，在从句中作 says 的宾语。
zh: 他说的话都应当认真对待。

content: The decision is ___ to make.
explanation: 名词性物主代词 yours 作表语。

content: It is a problem of ___ own making.
explanation: 形容词性物主代词 its 修饰 own making。
zh: 这是它自己造成的问题。

content: ___ of the candidates impressed the panel.
explanation: neither of + 复数，谓语单数，表示两者都不。
zh: 两位候选人都没给评审留下印象。

content: He considers ___ indispensable to the team.
explanation: 宾语与主语同指一人，用反身代词。
zh: 他认为自己对团队不可或缺。

content: ___ the outcome, we must remain calm.
explanation: whatever + 名词，表示「无论……是什么」。
zh: 无论结果如何，我们都必须保持冷静。

content: The report is ___ , not mine.
explanation: 名词性物主代词 hers 作表语。
zh: 这份报告是她的，不是我的。

content: ___ can be done has been done.
explanation: all that 引导定语从句；不能说 all what。

content: They prided ___ on their efficiency.
explanation: pride oneself on 意为「以……自豪」。
zh: 他们以自己的高效率自豪。

content: ___ is known to all, the earth is round.
explanation: as is known to all 是固定结构，as 指代整个主句。

content: I have nothing ___ to add.
explanation: further 指「进一步的」（抽象）；farther 指距离更远。

content: ___ of the two explanations is convincing.
explanation: 两者都用 neither，不用 none。
zh: 这两种解释都不能令人信服。

content: He is not ___ today — he seems distracted.
explanation: not oneself 意为「状态不佳」。
zh: 他今天状态不佳，看起来心不在焉。

content: ___ be the reason, the decision stands.
explanation: whatever 引导让步状语从句，在从句中作表语。
zh: 无论原因是什么，决定维持不变。

content: The blame lies with ___ is responsible.
explanation: whoever 在从句中作主语。

content: They regarded the proposal as ___ unworkable.
explanation: 强调「提案本身」，用反身代词。
zh: 他们认为该提案本身就行不通。

content: ___ else could have done it.
explanation: no one else 意为「没有别人」。

content: The results speak for ___ .
explanation: speak for themselves 意为「本身就说明问题」。

content: ___ of the arguments holds up.
explanation: 三个及以上用 none。
zh: 这些论点没有一个站得住脚。

content: One cannot help but admire ___ .
explanation: 此处 admire 的宾语指「他」而非主语 one，用宾格 him。

content: Such matters are best left to ___ .
explanation: leave sth to sb，介词后用宾格 them。
zh: 这类事情最好留给他们自己处理。

content: ___ the consequences, she went ahead.
explanation: whatever + 名词短语作让步状语。
zh: 无论后果如何，她还是继续推进了。
